run.target: Exact official sealed-content publisher proof component

groups.title: Owned source component and bounded backend evidence

rows.assertion: API encoding preserves exact raw Unicode/title/CRLF/HTML, rejects lossy scalars, sorts unique ASCII PIDs and emits fixed decimal integers.

rows.action: Document digest and full snapshot hash are independent
rows.assertion: Literal A/B snapshots with different authorization/audience-estimate facts have distinct full snapshot hashes but the same document digest.

rows.action: Official fresh-version seal association and immutability
rows.assertion: New-version same-TX seal insert succeeds; later backfill, UPDATE and DELETE are rejected by PostgreSQL.
Real submit and exemption entry methods call shared identity locking before the first root lock; release verifies existing seals without backfill.

rows.action: Publisher proof independent from recipient eligibility
rows.assertion: Enabled publisher owner with no recipient row obtains exact content and controlled approved binding; owner without publish is denied.

rows.action: Real observed source identity and missing history
rows.assertion: Actual local bytes, exact size/name/MIME and retention are bound; same-locator changed bytes and old missing seal cannot be certified.

rows.action: Original command physical transaction and lifetime
rows.assertion: Nested commands, escaped accessors, async use, actor/holder changes and growing lock sets are denied; handler close precedes valid commit revalidation.

rows.action: Commit-time official state and byte checks
rows.assertion: Withdrawal or actual byte replacement after successful proof causes commit refusal; withdrawn SQL mutation rolls back.

rows.action: Fresh permission reads without cache pollution
rows.assertion: All existing component cache loaders are reused without reading/writing shared caches; nested exceptions restore state, worker/other-tenant cached reads remain normal.

rows.action: Real uncommitted grant isolation and rollback
rows.assertion: Same-TX publish grant revocation is denied; uncommitted new grant is visible only in fresh scope, not another thread; rollback preserves normal cached results.

rows.action: Concurrent root writer waits for transaction lifetime
rows.assertion: Concurrent FOR UPDATE fails with exact PostgreSQL SQLSTATE55P03 while proof holds root, then succeeds after commit.
Removing commit revalidation makes actual withdrawal assertion red; restored source passes. Exact primary JARs match inventory and five tested class bytes.

rows.action: Root rich host issuance and single combined API
rows.assertion: Integrate source delta and issue Scope from Root-owned HandlerPhase with the richer API.
Run actual submit/prepare/freeze, real BPM approval and release worker; controlled terminal fixtures do not qualify this row.
Actual publisher command persists mapping from host proof and later recipient consent uses the independent digest/ack authorities.
Actual UI flow, external object-version atomicity and global IAM revocation linearizability are not inferred from this component.
